title: Rum & coca cola (jojo effects remix) - ANDREW SISTERS

lines.l: ...and daughter, working for the Yonkin Dalla...
Since the Yonki come to Trinidad,
they got the young girls all going mad.
Young girls say they treat them nice,
Native girls all dance and smile
Make every day like New Year's Eve
With the fact that it's a fun.
In old Trinidad I also fear,
Like the Yonkey girl, the native swoon,
It broke down point to Manaus
G.I. Romance is made of peach
All night long make Tropic love
Next day sit in hot sun and culo
drinking rum and coca-cola go down point kumana both mother and daughter working for the yonkee dollar
It's a fact, yeah, it's a fact.
